key_insight: PaddleMaterials unifies six materials-learning task classes in one toolkit while preserving task-specific representations and scientific semantics.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can connect materials discovery and characterization workflows and enable compiled execution through one setting without changing model definitions.
method: Unify data processing, training, evaluation and pretrained-model management across six task classes.
Record physical quantities, units, aggregation conventions and references for verifiable cross-task composition.
Use a shared compiler backend for graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted code generation.
evidence_signal: Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compilation accelerated every instance in eight groups; LiMnO2 formation-energy predictions were within 7 meV/atom of same-geometry PBE+U references, with model-step costs below one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation.
watch_item: Universal acceleration was reported for eight of eleven model groups, so speedups should be validated for the intended model and hardware.
paper_title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
